reason: A DSH provider adapter that connects users to CodeBuddy China models through WorkBuddy API keys or CodeBuddy account tokens, with model discovery and configuration in the WebUI.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 CodeBuddy 中国区模型，支持 WorkBuddy API Key 或 CodeBuddy 账号令牌认证及模型目录配置。
summaries.en: Adds a CodeBuddy China provider to DeepSeek Harness with WorkBuddy API key or CodeBuddy account-token authentication and configurable model discovery.

capabilities: Registers a CodeBuddy China provider in DSH
Sends model requests to CodeBuddy APIs using an API key or access token
Opens a browser for CodeBuddy account login and refreshes login tokens
Fetches and synchronizes the available model catalog
Stores API keys and login tokens through the DSH credential service
